title: Otherworldly Munchkin: Let’s Speedrun the Dungeon with Only 1 HP!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sixteen-year-old Yukito Kirihara is killed while protecting his 14-year-old sister Sana from an ogre. Reincarnated with a character sheet and only 1 HP, he finds Sana's name in the same book and sets out through dungeons to find and save her.
life_message: Devotion to family is worth any risk, and clever planning can beat overwhelming odds.
